title: NASA Made Atoms Colder Than 1 Kelvin
closing: The coldest known conditions are engineered by people, not hidden in deep space.
question: What can atoms reveal when almost all motion disappears?

segments.say: Deep space sits near 2.7 kelvin, far warmer than the laboratory experiment.
NASA chilled atoms to 0.0000000001 kelvin, below any known natural environment.
The experiment operates 250 miles above us, where weightlessness keeps ultracold atoms suspended.
